# ActionList

Figma: [07f. ActionList](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-947) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The grouped list container: it composes ListItems (07e) into a card with a section header, dividers between rows (last off) and a footer. Style (Grouped card / Plain) × Direction. Use it for settings, menus and grouped option lists.

### ActionList

Grouped list container that stacks ListItem rows under a section header with dividers (last off) and an optional footer hint, as a rounded card or plain edge-to-edge. The settings-screen building block.

Level: organism · Contains: ListItem

Use when:
- Settings sections such as Account, Notifications, Privacy (Style=Grouped)
- Account menus and payment methods lists
- Edge-to-edge lists in full-width layouts (Style=Plain)

Don't use when:
- A single row: use ListItem
- Choosing an option: use SelectionList
- Read-only content lists (bullets, key-value): use List
- Floating command lists: use Menu

Accessibility: Render as a list with the header as its label (aria-labelledby); footer text linked via aria-describedby.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |

| Has header | `hasHeader` | boolean |  | true |
| Has footer | `hasFooter` | boolean |  | true |
| Style | `style` | variant | Grouped, Plain | Grouped |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

ActionList is the container, not the row. It stacks ListItems (07e) into one group: a section header for context, rows with dividers between them (the last row’s divider off), and an optional footer for help text. Reach for it whenever rows belong together - settings sections, account menus, grouped choices.

### Composition

Each row is a ListItem instance - swap leading icons, titles, and trailing slots per row. ActionList only owns the grouping: the card surface, the header, the row dividers and the footer.

ListItem (07e) - one row

ActionList - rows grouped

### Styles

Grouped - a rounded card with border, for inset/settings layouts. Plain - full-width rows and dividers, for edge-to-edge lists.

Grouped

Plain

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Mirrors fully: the header and footer align to the trailing edge, rows mirror, and Arabic content right-aligns.

LTR

RTL

### Anatomy - header & footer

Header and footer are optional. Drop the header inside a labelled screen section; drop the footer when no help text is needed.

Header + footer

No header

No footer

### Examples & patterns

The same container, different intents - each row is a ListItem with the right slot boolean: chevron for navigation, toggle for preferences, value (+ label) for data, an action button for add-flows.

### Code examples

Flutter usage - pass ListItems as children; the container handles dividers and rounding.

### Grouped list

```dart
SafqahActionList(
  style: ActionListStyle.grouped,
  header: 'ACCOUNT',
  footer: 'Manage how Safqah reaches you and protects your data.',
  children: [
    SafqahListItem(leading: SafqahIcons.settings, title: 'Account & security', onTap: ...),
    SafqahListItem(leading: SafqahIcons.bell, title: 'Notifications', trailing: ListItemTrailing.toggle, ...),
    SafqahListItem(leading: SafqahIcons.shield, title: 'Privacy', onTap: ...),
  ],
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Group related rows under one clear header, and let ActionList own the dividers and rounded corners.

Don’t

Don’t hand-add dividers or round each row yourself - the container handles separators (last divider off automatically).

Do

Pick Plain for edge-to-edge lists; Grouped for inset/settings screens.

Don’t

Don’t mix unrelated topics in one list - split them into separate ActionLists, each with its own header.
